name: UpdatePrometheusAlertRule

parameters.help_en: The name of the alert rule
parameters.name: alert_name

parameters.help_en: The type of the alert rule
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The method that is used to send alert notifications. Valid values:

`ALERT_MANAGER`: Alert notifications are sent by Operation Center. This is the default value.

`DISPATCH_RULE`: Alert notifications are sent based on the specified notification policy
parameters.help_zh:
通知类型， 取值：

`ALERT_MANAGER`：通过告警运维中心通知。
`DISPATCH_RULE`：指定通知策略进行通知
parameters.name: notify_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the notification policy. This parameter is required if the NotifyType parameter is set to `DISPATCH_RULE`
parameters.help_zh: 通知策略ID，当NotifyType指定为`DISPATCH_RULE`时必填
parameters.name: dispatch_rule_id

parameters.help_en: The expression of the alert rule. The expression must follow the PromQL syntax
parameters.help_zh: 告警表达式，需要使用PromQL语句
parameters.name: expression

parameters.help_en: The duration. The value ranges from 1 to 1440 minutes
parameters.help_zh: 持续时间，范围在1m~1440m，单位为分钟
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en: The alert message. Tags can be referenced in the {{$labels.xxx}} format
parameters.help_zh: 告警消息，支持按照{{$labels.xxx}}格式来引用标签
parameters.name: message

parameters.help_en: The tags that are described in a JSON string. You must specify the name and value of each tag
parameters.help_zh: 标签JSON串。需要设置标签的Name和Value
parameters.name: labels

parameters.help_en: The annotations that are described in a JSON string. You must specify the name and value of each annotation
parameters.help_zh: 注释JSON串。需要设置注释的Name和Value
parameters.name: annotations

parameters.help_en: The ID of the alert rule. You can call the ListPrometheusAlertRules operation to query the ID of the alert rule
parameters.help_zh: 告警规则ID，您可以在ListPrometheusAlertRules API接口的返回数据中查看
parameters.name: alert_id
